7.10.1 Read DTC
The J1939-73 [14] standard defines various DM messages to report DTC information. The differences among these DM messages is mostly due to different filters on DTC states, such as active or pending DTCs, or on the OBD DTC class. The Dem provides a uniform way to read out the stored DTC information for these messages. The sequence diagram in figure 9.9 shows the general approach to retrieving the J1939 DTC information. The reporting content for different J1939 DM messages is accessed by using different input filter parameters.
[SWS_Dem_00855] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall set the filter mask attributes to be used for the subsequent calls of Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC and Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC, and reset an internal counter to the first event.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00856] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The filter mask attributes set via Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall be used until the next call of Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem initialization.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00857] ⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall return the current composite status of the J1939 lamps. The matching filter criteria are defined in Table 7.7.⌋ DM representation SetFilter Parameter UDS Status filter further filter criteria AllDTCs EmissionDTCs DEM_J1939DTC_ACTIVE (ConfirmedDTC == 1 AND TestFailed == 1) OR MIL_ON n/a DM01 DM12 DEM_J1939DTC _PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE ConfirmedDTC == 1 AND TestFailed == 0 AND MIL_OFF n/a DM02 DM23 DEM_J1939DTC_PENDING PendingDTC == 1 n/a DM27 DM06 DEM_J1939DTC_ PERMANENT n/a permanent memory entry available n/a DM28 DEM_J1939DTC _CURRENTLY_ACTIVE TestFailed == 1 n/a DM35 n/a Table 7.7: Types of errors which can be detected by the Dem module Each reading of DTC returns a composite lamp status of the following lamps:
a) Malfunction Indicator Lamp
b) Red Stop Lamp
c) Amber Warning Lamp
d) Protect Lamp
